rites.name: Sialia
rites.text: Sialia is a concept of Graikurn: the resonance held in the Singing, a tone that gathers as the first roots of the world take hold during the Holy Age. It is remembered as a pull toward order, where flame and temple orders take shape around the sound.

rites.name: Ilovanraoma
rites.text: Ilovanraoma is a concept of the Seeding in Graikurn, a quiet thread of power the makers pressed into the Weave before the sleeping powers woke. Its bearers in the Holy Age kept temple flames burning and measured their rites against it. It is less a force than a pattern that orders gather around.

rites.name: Teliasones
rites.text: Teliasones is the Seeding-time concept of the Weave, the thread-craft by which makers plant quiet powers into the world's ground so they may sleep until called. During the Holy Age of flame, temples and orders, the Weave was taught as a discipline of patience rather than force.

rites.name: Elarla
rites.text: Elarla is a concept of Graikurn's Grounded Realm, a quiet sleeping power that the makers planted during the Seeding, long before the Age of Sundering split old bonds apart. It is less a being than an idea of binding that waits beneath the fields and river valleys, stirring only when the land itself is disturbed.

rites.name: Thardoneld
rites.text: Thardoneld is a concept in the Graikurn Weave, a quiet pattern of thread that the makers planted during the Seeding to hold powers at rest. It belongs to the Age of Sundering, when landfall split old bonds and left the Weave frayed and uneven.

rites.name: Moranereld
rites.text: Moranereld is a concept born in Graikurn's Fall, when the old worlds split apart and their fragments drifted into the Shards. It names the stubborn bond that held certain shards together long enough for the Pact to be sworn.

rites.name: Vhagak
rites.text: Vhagak is a concept of Graikurn's Fall, a rite of flame and oath that the temple orders of the Holy Age used to bind the broken Shards to the Pact. It is remembered less as a force than as a discipline of kindled hearths and sworn vows.

rites.name: Graiktar
rites.text: Graiktar is a shadowed exchange of the Graikurn underworld, run through a web of brokers who trade in order codes of six characters. Each order is delivered to a hidden drop chosen by chance, and every sale leaves a tithe of favors and memory-tokens behind for those who arranged it.

rites.name: Kairkagar
rites.text: Kairkagar is a binding ritual in the Grounded realm of Graikurn, by which a drifting ghost-voice takes hold of a chosen role and wears its shape as flesh. The vessel grants skills, rights of passage, and tools bound to that role, and when the flesh is lost the voice is cast back out to wander until it finds another role to inhabit.

rites.name: Torougun
rites.text: Torougun is the hushed waiting-state of the Graikurn cosmos, a formless drift that every soul settles into between incarnations. Here no body ails and nothing is spent, and a wanderer may slip toward any mapped place by fixing their attention on it, though they cannot act until they claim a destiny that has gone unclaimed.

rites.name: Voraithar
rites.text: Voraithar is a creeping blight of the Grounded realm, a slow tide of rot that feeds on dead machines, unclaimed bodies, and black-market goods. Its strength is measured in the spreading tally that rises when repairs lapse and falls when the dead are burned and the stabilizers hum.

rites.name: Karuzhogok
rites.text: Karuzhogok is the bronze-stamped tally that the Hollow Assessors of Graikurn pay out as wages for remembered oaths and keep against anyone who breaks them. Its balance is written on a cord of knotted silver that every citizen wears at the wrist, and a debt below zero binds the debtor to labor at the nearest forge until repaid. Standing that falls far enough can strip a person of legal protection altogether, marking them with a sigil that lets any hand take their life unpunished.

rites.name: Kruzhathun
rites.text: Kruzhathun is a standing mark of exclusion in the Graikurn concept-space, stamped onto a rebel's record so that enforcers can recognize and eliminate them without question. Its authority swells whenever the city's decay index climbs past a threshold, letting the ruling wardens open sealed subterranean archives to themselves free of any consequence.

rites.name: Vhaikurn
rites.text: Vhaikurn is a salvage-rite practiced in the drowned districts of Graikurn, where scavengers coax usable parts from the refuse-hoards that gather in public bins. Those who live in the gutters claim the hidden caches beneath the sewer grates, while the ledger-keepers of the upper wards refuse to touch any of it.

rites.name: Vhouthar
rites.text: Vhouthar is a ration-cycle of the grounded city of Graikurn, a wheel of tallied grain and brewed drink that turns through its districts each dawn. Its keepers measure it in sacks and kettles rather than wonders, so it carries no great power beyond the labour it moves.

rites.name: Kakurn
rites.text: Kakurn is a clandestine foundry-and-apothecary network of linked crafting halls that hums beneath the cold harbor districts of Graikurn. Its output is gated by the craftsman's chosen calling, so a ledger-keeper may unlock what a field medic never could, and every tool must be tuned by hand before it works.

rites.name: Draktaithar
rites.text: In the labyrinthine underbelly of the cosmic metropolis, Zephyrion, lies the enigmatic Bazaar of Whispers, a clandestine marketplace where enigmatic Brokers orchestrate transactions using 6-symbol Chimes, fulfilled at unpredictable Echo Points. Prices ebb and flow via an inscrutable algorithm, and Brokers reap Temporal Credits and Echo Resonance for successful deals.

rites.name: Kugairkar
rites.text: Kugairkar is a sealed-ledger tithe system in the crowded terraces of Graikurn, where each citizen's allotment of stored heat is audited monthly by the lantern-clerks. Hidden seams called Gutterwells let residents quietly trade surplus heat outside the ledger, though the clerks periodically burn whole districts clean to recover what has slipped away.

rites.name: Khaigar
rites.text: Khaigar is a civic ledger-sigil issued to officials of the Graikurn administrative cortex, allowing them to mark a citizen as Commended or De-Commended and thereby nudge the Credit stipends of both parties. Any commendation later undone by a Limitation levies a steep memory-debt on the official who signed it.

rites.name: Karoukoggun
rites.text: Karoukoggun is a clandestine family of compounds brewed in the marshes of Graikurn, split between sanctioned Corpsman tinctures and back-alley workbench concoctions. Users chase surging strength and quick mending, but each dose lingers longer in the blood with every repetition, binding the body ever tighter to its next draught.

rites.name: Kraktar
rites.text: Kraktar is a grey, sweating ampoule of contraband tonic brewed in back-alley workbenches, and it is said to rewrite a living body into a single loyal engine of flesh. Its lineage is whispered among the underground tinkerers of Graikurn's lower wards, who swear that no two brews ever yield the same beast. Its true makers are rarely seen, and most who take it do not survive the first night.
